screens.title: Kurobayomi
screens.notes: Root container. Narrow window: bottom NavigationBar with icon + always-visible label (labelLarge, 1 line). Wide window: left NavigationRail with same items. Full tab set in order is Anime, Manga, Updates, History, Browse, More; the 'Navigation style' setting (bottom_rail_nav_style) removes exactly one of Manga / Updates / History / Browse from the bar and puts it as the first link row in More. Default style MOVE_HISTORY_TO_MORE -> bar shows Anime, Manga, Updates, Browse, More (the 'nav' array above) and History lives in More. Start screen default = Anime library. Badges: Updates icon shows a numeric Badge = new anime + new manga updates count (only if 'show unread count on Updates icon' pref is on); Browse icon shows a numeric Badge = pending extension updates (anime + manga). Re-selecting Updates opens Download queue; re-selecting History resumes last watched episode. Bottom bar hides while a screen is in selection mode. Content swaps with a 200ms material fade-through. Back on a non-start tab returns to the start tab. Library is NOT one tab with Anime/Manga sub-tabs: anime and manga libraries are two separate nav destinations with identical layouts. Updates, History, Download queue, Categories, Stats and Storage are each a single screen with a top 'Anime' | 'Manga' tab row (anime first).

screens.title: Anime

dialogs.title: Set categories
dialogs.text: You don't have any categories yet.

screens.notes: TOOLBAR (regular): SearchToolbar. Title = active category name ('Default' for uncategorized) or 'Anime' when only the default category exists / tabs hidden; when 'Show number of items' is on a small rounded Pill with the item count follows the title (14sp, onBackground @ 8% light / 12% dark). Actions: search icon (expands inline search field), Filter icon (FilterList; tinted 'active' accent color when any filter is active) opens the library settings sheet; overflow: Update library, Update category, Open random entry (snackbar 'No entries found in this category' if none). Snackbars: 'Updating category' / 'An update is already running'. CATEGORY TABS: PrimaryScrollableTabRow under the toolbar, shown when 'Show category tabs' is on and >1 category (or while searching); each tab = category name + optional count badge. Horizontal pager, one page per category. ITEMS by display mode: Compact grid = cover (2:3 book ratio, 4dp rounded) with title overlaid at bottom on a dark gradient (max 2 lines); Comfortable grid = cover then title below (max 2 lines, 4dp padding); Cover-only grid = cover only; List = row height auto (List size 0) or fixed rows per screen, 16dp horizontal / 3dp vertical padding, square-ish cover + title (1-2 lines) + badges at end. Grid spacing 4dp; columns 'Auto' (0) = adaptive by width. BADGES on cover top-start (grid) / end (list): Downloaded count (tertiary bg, onTertiary text) then Unseen count (primary bg); top-end: Language code uppercase (tertiary) or a folder icon for Local source. Continue button (when enabled & item has unseen): small round play FilledIconButton 28dp (icon 16dp) at cover bottom-end with 6dp padding, primaryContainer @ 90% alpha; in list mode 32dp at row end. Selected items: cover alpha reduced + 2dp primary outline / selected background. EMPTY: whole-library empty -> EmptyScreen face + 'Your library is empty' + action button 'Getting started guide' (help icon, opens website). Per-category page empty: 'Category is empty'; with filters: 'No match found'; with search: 'No results found' preceded by a full-width 'Search for "<query>" globally' button. SELECTION MODE (long-press; long-press another to select range): toolbar becomes action-mode with close (X), title = selected count, actions Select all (SelectAll icon), Select inverse (FlipToBack icon). Bottom nav hides and a bottom action bar appears: Set categories (Label icon), Mark as watched (DoneAll), Mark as unwatched (RemoveDone), Download (Download icon; hidden if any selected is Local; opens dropdown: 'Next episode', 'Next 5 episodes', 'Next 10 episodes', 'Next 25 episodes', 'Unseen'), Delete (Delete icon -> Remove dialog). Remove dialog: checkbox 'Downloaded episodes' hidden if selection contains a Local entry; OK disabled until a box is checked. Change category dialog: list of tri-state checkboxes (one per category), title row has 'Edit categories' text button that opens Categories; if no categories shows the text plus Cancel/Edit. Library settings sheet: modal bottom sheet (tabbed dialog in a wide window) with tabs Filter / Sort / Display. Filter: 'Downloaded' locked to include when global 'Downloaded only' is on; 'Customized update frequency' only in non-release builds; trackers: 0 logged in -> none, 1 -> single row 'Tracked', >1 -> 'Tracked' heading + one tristate per tracker. Sort: tapping active option toggles asc/desc arrow; 'Tracker score' only when a tracker is logged in; 'Random' has no direction, shows a refresh icon when active. Display: 'Items per row' slider becomes 'List size' (AYMR pref_library_rows) when mode is List; 0 shows 'Auto'. Overlay/Tabs rows are checkboxes.

dialogs.title: Set categories

screens.notes: Identical layout to anime_library (see its notes) with manga wording. Default title 'Manga'. Selection bottom bar: Set categories, Mark as read (DoneAll), Mark as unread (RemoveDone), Download (dropdown: 'Next chapter', 'Next 5 chapters', 'Next 10 chapters', 'Next 25 chapters', 'Unread'), Delete. Continue button resumes next unread chapter (snackbar 'Next chapter not found' if none). Sort has no 'Airing time'. Separate column prefs from anime (pref_library_columns_*). Shares display mode / badge / tab prefs with the anime library.

dialogs.title: Are you sure you want to delete the selected episodes?
Are you sure you want to delete the selected chapters?

screens.notes: Title 'Updates' with top PrimaryTabRow 'Anime' | 'Manga' (no search). Shows a back arrow only when opened from More (nav style). Toolbar (no selection): 'View Upcoming Updates' (CalendarMonth icon -> upcoming screen), 'Update library' (Refresh icon; snackbar 'Updating library' / 'An update is already running'). List (FastScrollLazyColumn): first row is small secondary text 'Library last updated: <relative time>' (16dp padding); then date group headers (ListGroupHeader: 'Today', 'Yesterday', 'N days ago' / date) followed by item rows. ROW: height 56dp, horizontal padding 16dp, selected background tint when selected. Left: square cover thumbnail (fills height, 6dp vertical padding, tap opens entry). Middle column (weight 1, 16dp horizontal padding): line 1 = entry title (bodyMedium, 1 line, ellipsis); line 2 = [8dp filled primary dot if unseen/unread] [primary Bookmark icon if bookmarked] [tertiary Label icon if fillermarked - anime only] episode/chapter name (bodySmall, 1 line) [' • ' + progress in disabled alpha: anime '12:34/24:00' watch position, manga 'Page: 5']. Seen/read rows render title+name at disabled alpha (0.38). Right: download indicator button (4dp start padding): outline download arrow / indeterminate ring / progress ring / filled check when downloaded; tap opens menu (Start/Cancel/Delete). Anime tap on downloaded episode with multiple qualities may open an episode options bottom sheet. Tap row = play/read; long-press = select (range select on second long-press). SELECTION MODE: toolbar actions Select all (SelectAll), Select inverse (FlipToBack); bottom nav hides; bottom action bar (each shown only when applicable): Bookmark episode / Unbookmark episode, Fillermark episode / Unfillermark episode (anime), Mark as watched / Mark as unwatched (manga: Mark as read / Mark as unread), Download, Delete (only if some selected are downloaded -> confirm dialog), Play externally / Play internally (anime, single selection). Opening the screen resets the new-updates badge. Empty: EmptyScreen 'No recent updates'.

screens.notes: Title 'History' with top tab row 'Anime' | 'Manga'; SearchToolbar (separate query per tab) + 'Clear history' action (DeleteSweep icon) -> 'Remove everything' dialog; snackbar 'History deleted'. Back arrow only when opened from More (default nav style). List grouped by date headers (Today / Yesterday / date). ROW: height 96dp, padding 16dp horizontal / 8dp vertical, whole row clickable = resume. Left: book cover (2:3, fills height, tap opens entry). Middle (weight 1, 16dp start, 8dp end): title (bodyMedium SemiBold, max 2 lines); below with 4dp top: 'Ep. 12 - 21:30' (manga 'Ch. 12 - 21:30'), or just the time if no number. Right: heart-outline IconButton 'Add to library' (only if not in library; may trigger duplicate dialog then Set categories dialog) and trash IconButton 'Delete' -> Remove dialog with reset-all checkbox. Empty: 'Nothing watched recently' (manga tab: 'Nothing read recently'); with search: 'No results found'. Snackbar 'Next Episode not found!' / 'Next chapter not found' when resuming fails. Re-selecting the History nav item resumes the last watched episode.

screens.title: Download queue
screens.notes: Top app bar with back arrow, title 'Download queue' + count Pill of queued items in the current tab. Actions (only when queue non-empty): Sort icon opens dropdown: 'By upload date' > 'Newest' / 'Oldest'; 'By episode number' (manga: 'By chapter number') > 'Ascending' / 'Descending'; overflow 'Cancel all'. Below: PrimaryTabRow 'Anime' | 'Manga', each tab text with a count badge. List grouped by source: header row = '<source name> (<count>)' with drag handle (8dp top margin) - whole group draggable. ITEM row: drag handle at start; line 1 entry title (bodyMedium, 1 line); line 2 episode/chapter name (12sp); right side progress text ('Downloading…' while indeterminate, anime '45%', manga 'pages/total'); a linear progress bar along the bottom (indeterminate at 0%); trailing 3-dot button opens popup: 'Move to top', 'Move series to top', 'Move to bottom', 'Move series to bottom', 'Cancel', 'Cancel all for this series' (top/bottom hidden when already first/last). Rows reorder by drag. Extended FAB bottom-end (only when list non-empty, collapses on scroll): anime tab 'Stop' (Pause icon) / 'Continue' (Play icon); manga tab 'Pause' / 'Resume'. Empty: 'No downloads'.

screens.notes: App bar with back arrow, title 'Categories', tab row 'Anime' | 'Manga'. Reorderable LazyColumn of ElevatedCards (8dp spacing, 16dp padding): each card row = drag handle icon (DragHandle, 16dp padding, drag to reorder), category name (weight 1, tap = rename), IconButtons: Edit ('Rename category'), Visibility/VisibilityOff ('Hide' - toggles hidden; shows Visibility when currently hidden), Delete. Default/system category not listed. Extended FAB bottom-end 'Add' with plus icon (collapses on scroll) -> Add category dialog. Name field error text 'A category with this name already exists!' when duplicate, '*required' supporting text when empty; confirm disabled while invalid. Empty: EmptyScreen with the empty text.

screens.notes: Reached from Settings > Data and storage. App bar with back arrow, title 'Storage', tab row 'Anime' | 'Manga'. Narrow window: single LazyColumn (8dp horizontal padding): header block centered = 'Category' outlined dropdown (All / Default / categories), then a semicircular gauge: 180° arc (rounded stroke caps) split into colored segments proportional to each entry's download size, with total size (e.g. '3.2 GB', displaySmall) centered inside the arc. Then one row per entry (16dp gap): 48dp square cover, column (weight 1): title (bodyMedium W700, 1 line) and a line with a 12dp circle in the entry's segment color, size text (bodySmall), a small dot separator, '24 episodes' / '24 chapters'; trailing Delete IconButton -> confirmation dialog. Wide window: header block on the left (weight 2), list on the right (weight 3).

items.title: New to Kurobayomi? We recommend checking out the getting started guide.

screens.notes: Shown on first launch. InfoScreen layout: large RocketLaunch icon top-start, heading 'Welcome!' (headlineLarge), subtitle 'Let's set some things up first. You can always change these in the settings later too.'; below, a rounded surfaceVariant box (fills remaining space, 8dp vertical padding) holding the current step, which slides horizontally (shared-axis X) between steps. Bottom bar: full-width filled button 'Next' ('Get started' on last step), disabled until the step is complete (storage step requires a folder). Back goes to previous step. Theme step: segmented System/Light/Dark buttons, then a horizontal scroll of theme preview cards (mini app mockups with name below, selected one outlined). Storage step: text, full-width buttons (create-folder button only on TV boxes when unset), divider, help text, 'Storage guide' button. Permission step: ListItems with title/subtitle and trailing OutlinedButton 'Grant' that becomes a check icon once granted (notification row only on Android 13+). Guides step: text + 'Getting started guide' button, divider, text + 'Restore backup' button.

screens.title: New version available!
screens.notes: InfoScreen layout: NewReleases icon, heading 'New version available!', subtitle = version name (e.g. 'v0.18.1.0'). Content: changelog rendered as Markdown (rich text, links colored primary), followed by a text button 'Open on GitHub' with trailing OpenInNew icon. Bottom: filled button 'Download' (starts app update download) and outlined button 'Not now'.

screens.title: Whoops!
screens.notes: InfoScreen layout: BugReport icon, heading 'Whoops!', subtitle 'Aniyomi ran into an unexpected error. We suggest you share the crash logs in our support channel on Discord.' Content: rounded surfaceVariant box (fills space, 8dp vertical padding) with the exception's toString() (e.g. 'java.lang.RuntimeException: ...') in onSurfaceVariant body text, 8dp padding. Bottom: filled button 'Share crash logs' (dumps logs to file and opens share sheet) and outlined button 'Restart the application'.
